examples.title: Single select
examples.description: Choose one value from a short option list.
examples.behavior: Trigger summarizes the selected value and opens a bounded option list.
examples.qa: Selected option is distinct from unselected options.

examples.title: Validation error
examples.description: Required selection has not been made.
examples.behavior: Error appears below the select and marks the trigger.
examples.qa: Error copy names the required decision.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Selection is fixed by policy or inherited context.
examples.behavior: Current value remains visible, menu cannot open.
examples.qa: Disabled affordance is visible without hiding the value.

default.qa: Trigger and selected value are legible.
